data.title: EWD
data.description: An Electronic Work Diary platform that digitises work and rest recording for drivers, transport operators, record keepers, and authorised officers — built to meet NHVR EWD Standards.
highlights: Simple driver interface for declaring work and rest periods
Real-time compliance checks aligned with NHVR fatigue rules
Intercept mode for authorised officers to quickly review records
Operator and record keeper dashboards for log management
Meets NHVR EWD Standards for performance and auditability
